summary: ansible --version shows the installed ansible-core version; ansible-community --version shows the ansible package version.
questions: How do I check which Ansible version is installed?
Why does ansible --version show a different number than the ansible package?
How do I see the ansible community package version?

answer_card.title: Check your Ansible version
answer_card.answer_md:
```console
ansible --version            # ansible-core version
ansible-community --version  # ansible package version
```
